_meta.description: Central manifest of all third-party code vendored into this repository, OS packages the panel depends on at runtime, and Eigenbau components with notable upstream inspiration. Update this file whenever a component is added, upgraded, or removed. License files for inline-vendored code must remain in their respective directories; this manifest points to them but does not replace them.

source_type_values.inline: Third-party source copied into the repo. HestiaRE carries the full license-compliance obligation — license file must live alongside the code.
source_type_values.os-package: Installed via apt. The distro ships the code; HestiaRE only declares the dependency. Verify GPL compatibility, but no obligation to ship a separate license file.
source_type_values.eigenbau: Written from scratch for HestiaRE. No upstream code copied. May reference an inspiration_source for audit clarity.

vendored.name: phpquoteshellarg
vendored.reason: Security-hardened shell argument quoting. PHP's native escapeshellarg() corrupts UTF-8 input (e.g. æøå) in processes running a non-UTF-8 locale. This implementation avoids the locale-dependent code path on Unix by wrapping in single quotes unconditionally.

vendored.name: alpinejs
vendored.reason: Panel UI interactivity framework (x-data bindings, stores, notifications, bulk edit). Prebuilt CDN artifact — the GitHub repo commits no dist files and attaches no release assets; the npm registry tarball is the project's official publish artifact (#248).

vendored.name: alpinejs-collapse
vendored.reason: Alpine collapse plugin (x-collapse transitions). Same monorepo and release cadence as alpinejs — updated together (#248).

vendored.name: normalize.css
vendored.reason: Cross-browser CSS reset, imported by the default panel theme. Vendored verbatim (upstream file is plain CSS, no build step). Project is finished software — no release since 2018, low update cadence expected.

vendored.name: fontawesome-free
vendored.modifications: solid.css: ../webfonts/ rewritten to /webfonts/ (panel serves fonts from web root). fontawesome.css and fa-solid-900.woff2 are byte-identical to the release artifact. Only the Solid style is shipped — the panel uses .fas exclusively (grep-verified); regular/brands CSS and webfonts are intentionally omitted (YAGNI).

vendored.name: adminer
vendored.reason: PostgreSQL web admin UI, offered as an addon (default-on when PostgreSQL is selected, #350). Vendored as the official pre-built single-file (EN, all drivers) rather than the OS `adminer` package: all four target distros ship CVE-affected versions (deb12/noble 4.8.1 with CVE-2023-45195/45196 + CVE-2025-43960; even 5.4.1 on 26.04 carries CVE-2026-25892, fixed only in 5.4.2) and there is no prebuilt pgsql-only asset. phpMyAdmin stays the MySQL default; the full build can also reach MySQL but is positioned as the Postgres UI. Canonical source is vrana/adminer — NOT AdminerEvo (repo closed/dead) or AdminNeo (sidebranch).

vendored.name: adminer-login-servers
vendored.reason: Adminer login-servers plugin, deployed alongside adminer.php by h-add-sys-adminer as adminer-plugins/login-servers.php. Restricts the login form's Server field to a fixed localhost dropdown so the panel Adminer cannot be pointed at an arbitrary remote host (SSRF hardening, #350/#356). Same upstream repo/version as the adminer single-file. The instantiation/config (share/adminer/adminer-plugins.php, localhost-only server list) is HestiaRE eigenbau, not vendored.

vendored.name: bootstrap-css
vendored.reason: Base UI styling for the File Manager (#218). The vendored TinyFileManager keeps Bootstrap's CSS (author decision: no reskin) while its Bootstrap-JS, jQuery, DataTables and Dropzone are dropped for vanilla JS + a tiny shim. Only dist/css/bootstrap.min.css is vendored — none of the JS bundle.

vendored.name: prismjs
vendored.source_url: jsDelivr /combine of prismjs@1.30.0 components: core,markup,css,clike,javascript,markup-templating,php,python,c,cpp,rust,yaml,batch,go,markdown,handlebars,csharp,powershell,apacheconf,json,bash,sql,ini,nginx,docker,perl,ruby,java,typescript + plugins/line-numbers; themes prism.min.css, prism-tomorrow.min.css, line-numbers.min.css
vendored.modifications: prism.js is a combined build (core + the 29 languages the FM highlights + the line-numbers plugin), assembled via jsDelivr /combine in the source_url order; the trailing sourceMappingURL comment is stripped. The three CSS files are the stock prism / prism-tomorrow / line-numbers themes, byte-identical.
vendored.reason: Syntax highlighting + line numbers for the FM read-only view and its Prism-overlay code editor (#218 P4/P5, no preview). Replaces the removed Ace + highlight.js.

vendored.name: tinyfilemanager
vendored.modifications: MAINTAINED FORK, not a verbatim copy. Pristine 2.6 baseline lives on upstream/tinyfilemanager; dev carries the HestiaRE integration + diet: run AS the customer (P2 $use_auth=false, P3 FM_ROOT, P-selfurl relative self-URLs), asset diet (P1 no CDN; Bootstrap-CSS + Prism vendored, FA7 from the panel), Ace->Prism overlay (P4), highlight.js->Prism (P5), Dropzone/DataTables/Bootstrap-JS/jQuery->vanilla+shim (P6-P9), FA4->FA7 (P10), sharing/direct-link removed (P11), plus a ?media= streaming handler and X-Hestia-Theme passthrough. sha256 is HestiaRE's forked file (changes each patch); source_sha256 is the pristine 2.6 baseline.
vendored.reason: The File Manager application (#218/#419 rebuild, replaces FileGator). Single-file PHP; runs in a per-customer php-fpm pool AS the customer so the kernel UID is the file-access boundary.

os_packages.name: libphp-phpmailer
os_packages.license_note: LGPL-2.1-only is compatible with GPL-3.0 per FSF guidance. Distributed by the OS — no obligation for HestiaRE to ship a separate license file.
os_packages.reason: Panel email delivery (password reset, 2FA notifications, admin alerts). Installed via apt — not vendored into the repo.

eigenbau.name: cloudflare-ip
eigenbau.license_obligation: none — independent reimplementation, no code copied. The Unlicense (public domain) would impose no obligations even if code had been copied.
eigenbau.independence_note: CIDR data sourced directly from cloudflare.com/ips-v4 and /ips-v6 (fetched 2026-06-21); ranges diverge from divinity76 (different fetch dates). Implementation uses filter_var() + runtime bitmask strings; divinity76 uses inet_pton() + precomputed integer ranges — different approach, zero shared code lines.
eigenbau.update_procedure: Replace CLOUDFLARE_IPV4_CIDRS and CLOUDFLARE_IPV6_CIDRS arrays from: curl https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v4/ and curl https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v6/

eigenbau.name: totp
eigenbau.note: Pure algorithm implementation. No upstream package. Uses only PHP built-ins: random_bytes, hash_hmac, hash_equals, pack.

eigenbau.name: qrcode
eigenbau.note: Pure algorithm implementation. No upstream package. Byte mode, ECC Level M, versions 1-10. No PHP extensions required.

eigenbau.name: randomString
eigenbau.license_obligation: none — independent reimplementation, no code copied.
eigenbau.note: Unbiased random string from a custom alphabet: crypto.getRandomValues + rejection sampling. Replaces the bundled nanoid dependency; only consumer is helpers.js randomPassword() (#248).

eigenbau.name: passwordStrength
eigenbau.license_obligation: none — independent reimplementation, no code copied.
eigenbau.note: Password strength level 0-3 from length + character-class diversity, mirroring the rule model of check-password-strength's default options so the <meter> semantics stay identical. Only consumer is passwordInput.js (#248).

eigenbau.name: swing-animation
eigenbau.license_obligation: none — independent reimplementation with own keyframe timing/values, no code copied.
eigenbau.note: Replaces the trimmed animate.css excerpt (web/css/src/dependencies/animate.css, removed 2026-07-04). Animate.css v4 is licensed under the Hippocratic License 2.1 — not OSI-approved and GPL-incompatible. The panel used exactly one animation (notification-bell swing), so the excerpt was replaced by a single Eigenbau keyframe utility; the unused fadeIn/zoomIn keyframes were dropped.
